# Temple Scroll Column 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 2 | **Condition:** Heavily damaged; partial lines survive

---

**2:1** [...] and-I-shall-consecrate [my] tem[ple ...]

**2:2** [...] in-which I-will-cause-to-dwell [my] glory [...]

**2:3** [...] upon it the-cloud [...] and-I-shall-appear to-them [...]

**2:4** [...] until the-day-of-creation [when] I-shall-create my-temple [...]

**2:5** [...] and-I-shall-establish it for-myself for-all the-days [...]

**2:6** [...] according-to the-covenant which I-cut with-Jacob [...]

**2:7** [...] at Bethel [...]

**2:8** [...] covenant [...] I-shall-establish [...]

**2:9** [...] for-them [...] a-covenant of-eternity [...]

**2:10** [...] and-I-shall-be to-them a-God [...]

**2:11** [...] and-they shall-be to-me a-people [...]

**2:12** [...] in the-midst-of my-sanctuary for-ever-and-ever [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 2 is heavily damaged but preserves God's first-person speech — the distinctive feature of the Temple Scroll. Key surviving phrases include the consecration of the temple, the indwelling of divine glory, and the eternal covenant formula ("I shall be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people"). The "day of creation" (yom ha-beri'ah) refers to God's eschatological re-creation of the temple. Hyphenated compounds reflect Hebrew construct chains and verb-preposition combinations.*
